sentences.text: A&E -LRB- previously Arts & Entertainment Network -RRB- is an American cable and satellite television channel that serves as the flagship television property of A&E Networks , a joint venture between the Hearst Corporation and Disney -- ABC Television Group subsidiary of the Walt Disney Company -LRB- both of which maintain a 50 % ownership interest -RRB- .	A&E Networks	A&E Networks	Hearst Corporation	Hearst Corporation	cable	cable television	satellite television	satellite television	the Walt Disney Company	the Walt Disney Company

The channel originally focused programming on biographies , documentaries , and drama series -LRB- especially crime dramas and mysteries -RRB- but has later expanded to include reality television programming .	biographies	biography	drama	drama	reality television	reality television

As of July 2015 , the A&E network is available to approximately 95,968,000 pay television households -LRB- 82.4 % of households with television -RRB- in the United States .	United States	United States

The channel is headquartered in New York City and operates offices in Atlanta , Georgia ; Chicago , Illinois ; Detroit , Michigan ; London , United Kingdom ; Los Angeles , California and Stamford , Connecticut .	New York City	New York City	New York	New York (state)

The U.S. version of the channel is shown in Canada while international versions exist for Australia , Latin America , and Europe .	Canada	Canada	Australia	Australia	Latin America	Latin America	Europe	Europe
